verdict.rationale: Glama's docs clearly support publishing (connect GitHub or ship Dockerfile/npm/PyPI, private/public toggle, ownership claim token, registry listing with pre-filled client configs) [glama-docs-2, glama-docs-3, glama-docs-8, glama-docs-16, glama-docs-14]. But hands-on community reports contradict a smooth publish flow: after updating a version, the quality-score rebuild silently failed to rerun for days due to an undocumented requirement to add billing credits, and neither the user nor their AI agent could diagnose it from docs [glama-comm-2, glama-comm-3]; another user also notes it's hard to get a new MCP noticed amid the large catalog [glama-comm-4]. Missing for 10: reliable, well-documented rebuild/publish pipeline and independent confirmation that discovery/installation works smoothly post-fix.
